description: This file defines the SaveClaimController class, which handles the pre-render logic for claim-related views in the OrangeHRM system. It extends AbstractVueController and sets up Vue components based on request attributes.

classes.name: SaveClaimController
classes.description: Controller managing the pre-render setup for claim editing or creation views, selecting appropriate Vue components based on request parameters.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Sets the Vue component ('claim-event-edit' or 'claim-event-create') based on whether an 'id' attribute is present in the request.
